title: Touring with the Topsy band

blocks.x: Oh yes, I did quite a bit of travelling with "Topsy."
Well just all over, around Detroit, Philly, Detroit, Philly, New York, of course Chicago. Oh what is that, Baker's Keyboard Lounge in Detroit there.
He is? Yeah. Baker's Keyboard, Philadelphia,

So I did quite a bit of travelling with the band I had for 'Topsy.' See, I kept that band oh about six years in Cincinnati we played the Living Room; any number of times we played there. We kept getting calls to come back.
So it sounds like a pretty successful band then.
Oh yeah, it was. Very, we were busy for about six years.
So when did you stop traveling with your own band?
Around '66, 1966 is when we broke up.
